tools.name: create_entities
tools.description: Create multiple new entities in the knowledge graph. An entity whose name already exists, or repeats an earlier entity in the same call, is skipped and its observations are not added; the result lists the skipped names in `skipped`. Use add_observations to add observations to an existing entity.

tools.name: create_relations
tools.description: Create multiple new relations between entities in the knowledge graph. Relations should be in active voice

tools.name: add_observations
tools.description: Add new observations to existing entities in the knowledge graph

tools.name: delete_entities
tools.description: Delete multiple entities and their associated relations from the knowledge graph

tools.name: delete_observations
tools.description: Delete specific observations from entities in the knowledge graph

tools.name: delete_relations
tools.description: Delete multiple relations from the knowledge graph

tools.name: read_graph
tools.description: Read the entire knowledge graph: every entity with its observations, and every relation. The result grows with the graph, so use this only when you need everything; prefer search_nodes to find entities by keyword and open_nodes to read entities whose names you know.

tools.name: search_nodes
tools.description: Search the knowledge graph for entities whose name, type or observations contain the query (case-insensitive). Use this when you have a keyword, a topic or part of a name but not the exact entity names. Prefer open_nodes when you already know the exact names, and use read_graph only when you need the whole graph. Returns the matching entities and every relation that touches one of them.

tools.name: open_nodes
tools.description: Retrieve specific entities by their exact names, with every relation that touches one of them. Use this when you already know the names (from the conversation, or from an earlier search_nodes or read_graph result); it is the cheapest way to read entities you can name. Prefer search_nodes when you only have a keyword or part of a name. Names that do not exist are skipped.
